single_hop_baseline.description: All 2,691 Zircolite-compiled SigmaHQ rules, run against every record in each corpus (all Sysmon/Security/System event types, not just EventID 1 process creation) via direct re-execution of their compiled SQL (see evidence/single_hop_scoring.json).

tree_detector_uac_bypass_proxy_chain.description: This project's Detector 1 (T1548.002): auto-elevating binary -> intermediary -> shell/interpreter, 2 hops down. See evidence/tree_detector_results.json.

tree_detector_deep_chain_to_lolbin.description: This project's Detector 2 (T1218): a process chain reaches a LOLBAS-listed binary 4+ processes deep. REPORTED AS A NEGATIVE RESULT: see FINDINGS.md, this detector fires promiscuously on benign infrastructure (conhost.exe, ngen.exe) and does not discriminate malicious from benign chains even after excluding those two names.

case_study_sdclt_uac_bypass.description: The 2 real payload-launch events (sdclt.exe -> control.exe -> powershell.exe, from the OTRF/Mordor APT29 evaluation capture in the malicious corpus) that Detector 1 catches. Existing single-hop rule 'Sdclt Child Processes' (da2738f2-fadb-4394-afa7-0a0674885afa) matches the INTERMEDIARY control.exe event (one hop from sdclt.exe) but never the powershell.exe event where the payload actually executes, because that event's ParentImage is control.exe, not sdclt.exe.
